projectDescription: A Python-based Tetris game controlled entirely by hand gestures captured through your webcam, powered by computer vision.
keyFeatures: Gesture-based controls using hand tracking via webcam
Real-time hand detection with MediaPipe and CVZone
Classic Tetris mechanics (line clearing, leveling, combos)
Shadow piece preview for landing position
Sound effects for level-up, line clear, game over, and high score beaten
Works alongside the browser-based Tetris game at tetris.com
Supports both left and right hand input
publicApiSurface: Left hand: pinky up → move left
Left hand: thumb up → rotate left
Left hand: all fingers up → hard drop
Left hand: thumb only up → move down
Right hand: pointer finger up → move right
Right hand: thumb up → rotate right
Right hand: all fingers up → hard drop
Right hand: thumb only up → move down
Keyboard: Arrow keys / WASD → fallback controls
